scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:test-cheatsheet && npm run generate:pages
scripts.test:browser: env -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR playwright test browser-tests/responsive-browser.ts
scripts.test:browser:production: env -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR TOKENBENCH_BROWSER_ASSET_MODE=production playwright test --config=playwright.production.config.ts browser-tests/responsive-browser.ts
scripts.test:mockups: npm test -- scripts/*mockup*.test.ts && env -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR playwright test --config=playwright.mockups.config.ts
scripts.types:workers: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types workers/catalog-ingest/worker-configuration.d.ts --config workers/catalog-ingest/wrangler.toml --env-interface CatalogIngestEnv && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types workers/benchmark-ingest/worker-configuration.d.ts --config workers/benchmark-ingest/wrangler.toml --env-interface BenchmarkIngestEnv
scripts.types:workers:check: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types workers/catalog-ingest/worker-configuration.d.ts --config workers/catalog-ingest/wrangler.toml --env-interface CatalogIngestEnv --check && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types workers/benchmark-ingest/worker-configuration.d.ts --config workers/benchmark-ingest/wrangler.toml --env-interface BenchmarkIngestEnv --check
